sourceBinding.reason: Object-owned recipe: the datasets, their pinned program and bands, the stated conventions and the published geometry each is checked against.

The publisher's color map the dust dataset is shown in, read from the published figure as the file itself records (Kraus et al. (2020), Science 369, 1233, Figure 1A, as printed in the accepted manuscript (ESO science paper eso2014a.pdf, page 20). Colors read up the figure’s color bar; its nine printed flux ticks calibrate a power transfer through zero. 1024 entries sample equal flux intervals. This is a false-color brightness display for millimeter emission, not visible color.).
